outcome: Volume of bupivacaine required to achieve T6 level
cohort: 64 patients undergoing elective caesarean section under epidural anesthesia
finding: Adding 50 μg fentanyl to epidural 0.5% bupivacaine significantly reduced VAS scores, decreased intraoperative analgesic supplementation, and prolonged the duration of postoperative analgesia without affecting other epidural block characteristics or neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: The addition of fentanyl to epidural bupivacaine did not negatively affect neonatal outcomes, as measured by Apgar scores.
